description: Search the Eurostat catalogue by keyword for dataset codes, with labels, period coverage and theme breadcrumbs; datasets and predefined tables only, no folders. Pass a code to eurostat_get_dataset_info, then eurostat_query_dataset for a slice or eurostat_download_dataset for the whole dataset. The catalogue joins the dissemination table of contents with the Comext host's dataflow list, which adds the DS-* collections (detailed trade by CN8, HS, SITC, BEC and CPA, and PRODCOM); Comext entries report a last-update date but no period coverage or observation count. A collection on neither list, such as the legacy PRODCOM DS-056120, is not disseminated and cannot be reached.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first. Bound to its query and to the catalogue snapshot that issued it: sent with another query, or after the catalogue refreshes, it is rejected.

limit.description: Datasets per page, default 20; values above 100 clamp to 100 with a notice. Fixed by the first call and ignored with cursor.

query.description: Search words, at least one. Every word must match, in any order and ignoring case, somewhere in the dataset label, theme breadcrumb or code. Spacing beside punctuation in the catalogue is ignored ("Rev.2" finds "Rev. 2"); a word keeps its own punctuation ("R&D", "DS-045409"). When no dataset holds every word, a query of up to 10 distinct words is searched again, each word a dataset lacks also matching at the start of a word in the English label of one of its dimension values (time excluded); those rows carry matchedValues. When nothing matches, the error names the words to drop.

name: eurostat_search_datasets

catalogueLoadedAt.description: When the catalogue that answered was loaded (ISO 8601); present only when a failed refresh left that older copy in service.

comextListMissing.description: True when the Comext dataflow list could not be loaded, so the DS-* collections were not searched and totalMatches counts the table of contents alone. Omitted otherwise.

datasets.description: This page of matches, up to limit, ordered: the query as a phrase from the start of a label word, then a label or code holding every word, then a match only through the theme breadcrumb; table-of-contents order within each group. Rows with matchedValues come by fewest words found only in value labels, then one value's label carrying all of them, then the groups above.

code.description: Dataset code (e.g., "nama_10_gdp") for eurostat_get_dataset_info, eurostat_query_dataset and eurostat_download_dataset.

dataEnd.description: Latest period (e.g., "2025"); omitted when not reported.

dataStart.description: Earliest period (e.g., "1975"); omitted when not reported.

lastUpdated.description: Date of the last data update (e.g., "22.05.2026"); omitted when not reported.

matchedValues.description: Only when no dataset's own text holds every query word: this dataset's dimension values whose labels carry the words its text lacks, those carrying the most words first, then in Eurostat's order.

items.description: A dimension value whose label carries a query word.

code.description: Value code (e.g., "PHARM"), the value in those filters.

dimension.description: Dimension code (e.g., "med_spec"), the key in eurostat_query_dataset filters.

obsCount.description: Approximate observation count; omitted when not reported.

themePath.description: Breadcrumb from the root theme to this dataset; for a dataset filed under several branches, the first that matched. Empty for top-level entries.

type.description: Entry type: "dataset", or "table" for a predefined table.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No dataset matched the query. A DS-* code on neither catalogue list is not disseminated; while the Comext list cannot be loaded, only the table of contents is searched. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed, came from another query, or predates a catalogue or value-index refresh. `upstream_fault`: No catalogue was loaded yet and Eurostat's table of contents could not be read: marked retryable after a timeout, rate limit, server error or unreachable host on every retry, not after a refusal Eurostat would repeat. Once a catalogue is loaded, a failed refresh serves that copy instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted on the last page.

nextStep.description: Suggested next call, when one is clear.

notice.description: Says when results came through dimension value labels, and names any part of the catalogue missing from this answer and what to do about it.

totalMatches.description: Distinct datasets matching across all pages.

truncated.description: True when more matches follow; pass nextCursor as cursor for them.

title: Search Eurostat Datasets
